basis: Indicative blended toll for a 40 t / 5-axle / EURO VI articulated combination, expressed in EUR per kilometre across the motorway and tolled trunk network.
disclaimer: ESTIMATE ONLY. Rates are averages and do not represent an official tariff. Vignette / time-based countries are listed at 0.00 EUR/km with a note. Always verify with the national toll operator before departure.

AL.name: Albania
AL.notes: Only a few tolled sections; most of the network is free.

AD.name: Andorra
AD.notes: No HGV road charge; customs formalities apply.

AT.name: Austria
AT.notes: GO-Box on-board unit mandatory. Special tariffs on A13 Brenner, A9, A10, A11 and S16.

BY.name: Belarus
BY.notes: On-board unit required. Non-EU customs and permit rules apply.

BE.name: Belgium
BE.notes: Applies to vehicles over 3.5 t on all roads; rate varies by region and EURO class.

BA.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
BA.notes: Cash or card at barriers; green card insurance required.

BG.name: Bulgaria
BG.notes: Route pass or OBU. Vehicles over 3.5 t are distance charged.

HR.name: Croatia
HR.notes: Barrier system; ENC transponder gives a discount.

CZ.name: Czechia
CZ.notes: OBU mandatory over 3.5 t on motorways and selected 1st class roads.

DK.name: Denmark
DK.notes: Replaced the Eurovignette for heavy goods vehicles. Great Belt and Oresund bridges are charged separately.

EE.name: Estonia
EE.notes: Daily, weekly or monthly charge, not per kilometre. Budget separately.

FI.name: Finland
FI.notes: No road user charge; ferry costs may dominate.

FR.name: France
FR.notes: Barrier and free-flow tolls. Telepeage badge recommended. Alpine tunnels charged separately.

DE.name: Germany
DE.notes: Applies from 3.5 t on all federal roads. Includes the CO2 emission-class surcharge.

GR.name: Greece
GR.notes: Barrier system; e-pass transponders differ per concession.

HU.name: Hungary
HU.notes: Route ticket or OBU mandatory over 3.5 t.

IS.name: Iceland
IS.notes: Only a few tunnels are charged.

IE.name: Ireland
IE.notes: M50 is barrier-free with mandatory online payment by 20:00 the next day.

IT.name: Italy
IT.notes: Telepass recommended. Frejus and Mont Blanc tunnels charged separately.

XK.name: Kosovo
XK.notes: Small tolled network; check documentation requirements.

LV.name: Latvia
LV.notes: Daily to yearly vignette for vehicles over 3 t. Not per kilometre.

LI.name: Liechtenstein
LI.notes: Performance-related heavy vehicle fee, same scheme as Switzerland.

LT.name: Lithuania
LT.notes: Charging by kilometre on the main network for vehicles over 3.5 t.

LU.name: Luxembourg
LU.notes: Time-based Eurovignette shared with NL and SE. Not per kilometre.

MD.name: Moldova
MD.notes: Time-based vignette; the per-km figure is an indicative equivalent.

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.notes: Time-based today. Westerschelde and Kil tunnels are charged separately.

NO.name: Norway
NO.notes: Dense ring of toll stations around cities; AutoPASS tag required for HGV.

PL.name: Poland
PL.notes: Mandatory geolocation app or OBU over 3.5 t.

PT.name: Portugal
PT.notes: Several free-flow motorways require a transponder or pre-registration.

RO.name: Romania
RO.notes: Time-based vignette. Fetesti-Cernavoda bridge tolled separately.

RU.name: Russia
RU.notes: OBU required over 12 t. Non-EU customs, permit and sanction rules apply.

RS.name: Serbia
RS.notes: Category 3 or 4 for heavy combinations; green card required.

SK.name: Slovakia
SK.notes: OBU mandatory over 3.5 t on motorways and 1st class roads.

SI.name: Slovenia
SI.notes: DarsGo unit mandatory over 3.5 t. Karawanks tunnel charged separately.

ES.name: Spain
ES.notes: Many AP motorways have reverted to free use; the rate is a network average.

SE.name: Sweden
SE.notes: Time-based Eurovignette. Stockholm and Gothenburg congestion charges apply separately.

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.notes: Performance-related heavy vehicle fee on ALL roads. Highest per-km charge in Europe.

TR.name: Turkey
TR.notes: Electronic sticker mandatory; bridges charged separately.

UA.name: Ukraine
UA.notes: Weight and dimension permits apply. Check current security and border guidance.

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.notes: Time-based levy. Dartford Crossing, M6 Toll and Mersey crossings charged separately.
